HouseListing.title: HouseListing
HouseListing.description: Public residential rental or sale listing without owner PII (phone numbers are stored separately in HouseContact).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who posted the listing.

type.description: Listing type in Amharic: ኪራይ (Rent) or ሽያጭ (Sale).

location.description: Neighborhood or subcity in Addis Ababa / Ethiopia.

priceDisplay.description: Formatted display price in Ethiopian Birr.

priceAmount.description: Numeric price in Ethiopian Birr for sorting/filtering.

areaSqm.description: Approximate floor or plot area in square meters.

description.description: Additional property details provided by the owner.

imageKey.description: Bundled visual category key for property artwork.

isStarter.description: Whether this listing is part of the initial showcase catalog.

HouseContact.title: HouseContact
HouseContact.description: Isolated PII sub-document holding the owner's direct phone number, readable only by the owner or users with an unlock receipt.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the listing owner.

phone.description: Direct Ethiopian phone number of the property owner.

ownerName.description: Optional display name of the property owner.

ContactUnlock.title: ContactUnlock
ContactUnlock.description: Immutable receipt proving the user paid the 50 ETB Telebirr unlock fee for a specific house listing.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who unlocked the contact.

houseId.description: Document ID of the unlocked house listing.

/houses/{houseId}.description: Publicly browsable house rental and sale listings without owner phone PII.

/houses/{houseId}/contact/{contactId}.description: Private contact info document ('private') gated by ownership or a verified unlock receipt.

/users/{userId}/unlocks/{houseId}.description: Per-user immutable receipts of unlocked house owner phone numbers.
